patterns.note: Full-width hero with a centrally aligned, multi-faceted search bar, immediately followed by horizontally scrollable card carousels for property listings.
A clear, modern sans-serif typeface (Google Sans/Roboto) is used consistently, with bold, larger weights for headings and a lighter weight for body text, ensuring readability and hierarchy.
A high-contrast color scheme featuring a dominant, bright red for all primary calls to action and branding, set against clean white and subtle light gray backgrounds.
A persistent, sticky navigation bar at the top of the viewport that maintains full functionality and appearance as the user scrolls down the page.
Property listings are presented as a horizontally scrollable carousel of uniform cards, each featuring a large image, price, key property details, and interactive icons.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero image serves as a backdrop for a prominent, centrally-aligned search input field, which is further enhanced by a subtle dark overlay to ensure high contrast for overlaid text and interactive elements.
Key content sections are visually delineated by alternating background colors (white and light gray), providing clear breaks and structure to the page flow.
Interactive content, such as property listings and service explanations, is presented in a card-based format, arranged in horizontal carousels that allow users to browse multiple items efficiently.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and significantly larger than body text, creating a clear hierarchy, with a strong contrast between the hero headline and smaller supporting text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card corners (e.g., property listings, search input).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing, with airy sections (like the hero) and more dense, grid-like arrangements for content cards.

standout: The site's design stands out with its immediate and highly functional search-centric hero, which integrates a multi-option search bar directly into a visually appealing background. This, combined with the prominent, scrollable property listing cards right below the fold, creates a highly efficient and direct user experience focused on property discovery.
